phase: Independent stricter Phase 1 confirmation after the initial factorial near miss
selection_history: This design responds to the earlier study's unmatched simple four-edge paths. All earlier outcomes, including the failed success criterion, remain public in PHASE1_REPORT.md. Fresh graph classes and seeds are selected without model outcomes from this cohort.

matched_graph_statistics: simple four-edge paths between focal entities
design.architecture: same 48-dimensional two-layer two-tower Transformer and data generator as the initial 12-entity factorial
design.balanced_distractors: exact balance for each semantic candidate over five-epoch blocks
design.evaluation: fixed 320-rendering focal suite: two directions, two events, four answer positions, ten distractors, two scene repeats; independent scene seeds 260107 and 260108
design.preflight: The identical architecture and generator passed the earlier, outcome-blind 12-entity development-graph preflight at 98.91 percent familiar accuracy; no strict-cohort held results used before freeze.

hypotheses.H_CN: Increasing focal common partners from one to two reduces unseen-pair role accuracy at both fixed three-edge-path levels.
hypotheses.H_P3: Increasing simple three-edge paths from three to four improves unseen-pair role accuracy at both fixed common-partner levels.
hypotheses.alternative: One, both, neither, or an interaction may account for the original rewiring effect.

primary_endpoint: Final-checkpoint focal-pair binary correct-vs-role-reversed accuracy, first scene suite; average three paired seeds within each graph family, then eight families equally.
tests: Exact two-sided sign-flip p across eight family effects for each of two primary contrasts; Holm adjustment at familywise 0.05; 95 percent family t intervals also reported.
practical_success: At least one primary contrast has Holm-adjusted p<=0.05 and absolute mean effect >=0.10, with all conditions' familiar four-choice accuracy >=0.95. Directional hypotheses are supported only when the significant contrast has the predicted sign.
missingness: No family or seed replacement based on outcomes; rerun only documented technical failures with the same configuration.
interpretation_limit: Even with the matched graph statistics, edge switches alter the identities of observed pairs and may alter other local motifs. A positive result supports a structural intervention effect under these constraints, not a unique neural mechanism.
